rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when identifying someone by nationality, replacing X with a country name.
Use this for a compatriot or fellow citizen, especially when contrasting people from the same country with foreigners.

example.english: When we meet a fellow countryman abroad, we really feel a sense of closeness.
example.traditional: 我哋喺外國遇到同胞，真係覺得好親切。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hai2 ngoi6 gwok3 jyu6 dou3 tung4 baau1 zan1 hai6 gok3 dak1 hou2 can1 cit3

rows.note: Use this for someone who lives in the countryside; it can also suggest a rustic or unsophisticated person.

example.english: My countryman cousin lives in the New Territories and works in the fields every day.
example.traditional: 我個鄉下人表弟住喺新界，日日都落田做嘢。
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 hoeng1 haa6 jan4 biu2 dai6 zyu6 hai2 san1 gaai3 jat6 jat6 dou1 lok6 tin4 zou6 je5
